name: Nitrogen Pump / Converter Unit
summary: High-performance nitrogen pump/converter unit for well stimulation, pressure testing, nitrogen lifting, and other oilfield operations.
description: The units are designed for reliable and efficient conversion of liquid nitrogen into high-pressure nitrogen gas, providing a high-capacity solution for demanding oilfield operations.
specs: Nitrogen gas output: up to 180,000 SCF/hr
Maximum working pressure: up to 15,000 PSI
Standard pressure ratings: 10,000 PSI (690 bar) and 14,500 PSI (1,000 bar)
Hazardous area certification: Zone II (other certification options available on request)
